title: Hardeep Puri On Cutting India’s Fossil Fuel Imports, Green Hydrogen Push & Samudra Manthan
description: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri outlines India’s strategy to reduce dependence on imported fossil fuels, highlighting efforts across domestic oil exploration, biofuels and green hydrogen. Puri said the government’s Samudra Manthan scheme will support drilling of 150 wells over three years, with a budgetary allocation already provided. He also highlighted India’s 20% ethanol blending milestone and said the blending level will remain at 20%. On green hydrogen, Puri stressed the need to reduce costs and expand its use across different sectors of the economy, calling it “the fuel of the future.”

title: Ancient genome function persists despite frequent mutations
description: A new Nature study led by HHU Düsseldorf and MPIPZ Cologne with Dr Lisa Smith and Professor Jurriaan Ton reveals the process by which centromeres change their sequence rapidly over time.

title: How to relax and detox through ikebana, the ancient Japanese art of flower arranging
description: Ikebana, the Japanese art of arranging flowers, is a form of expression that dates back more than 500 years. It continues to blossom quietly – not only with traditionalists, but also with newcomers who find its blend of creativity and mindfulness to be restorative. Ikebana can be a bit like solving a puzzle, except there is no fixed answer.
